entry.title: Packages
entry.summary:
Motion Picture Booth Packages

Drop-Off Booth Package

Starting at $250

A self-service booth designed for smaller events and budget-conscious clients.

Includes

  • iPad camera booth

  • Open-air setup

  • Delivery, setup, and pickup

  • Digital props

  • Digital copies

  • Custom template design

  • On-call customer support

Take One Package

$500

An entry-level DSLR photo booth experience.

Includes

  • 2-hour DSLR photo booth rental

  • Open booth

  • Unlimited sessions

  • Unlimited prints

  • Custom print design

  • On-site attendant

  • Props

  • Digital gallery

  • Fabric backdrop

  • Setup and teardown included

Best for: Birthday parties, baby showers, and small gatherings.

Director's Cut Package

$1,000 (Regularly $1,300 — 23% savings)

Upgrades the experience with more time and an enclosed booth.

Includes

Everything in Take One, plus:

  • 4-hour DSLR photo booth rental

  • Choice of:

    • 10'×10' canopy, or

    • 8'×8' enclosed booth

  • Glam filter option

  • Two on-site attendants

  • USB drive with photos

  • Digital gallery

  • Fabric or custom backdrop

Best for: Weddings, corporate events, and larger celebrations.

Hollywood Deluxe Package

$1,500 (Regularly $2,700 — 44% savings)

The premium experience combining the enclosed booth with a 360° video setup.

Includes

Everything in Director's Cut, plus:

  • 5-hour DSLR + 360° video rental

  • Up to four on-site attendants

  • Scrapbook station

  • Fabric backdrop, custom backdrop, or CGI green screen

Best for: Luxury weddings, quinceañeras, galas, and large events.

Package Comparison

Package Price Booth Type Duration Attendants Prints 360 Video
Drop-Off Booth From $250 Open (iPad) Varies On-call support Digital only —
Take One $500 Open DSLR 2 hrs 1 ✓ Unlimited —
Director's Cut $1,000 Enclosed DSLR 4 hrs 2 ✓ Unlimited —
Hollywood Deluxe $1,500 Enclosed DSLR + 360° 5 hrs Up to 4 ✓ Unlimited ✓

Contact

Phone: (714) 348-3922
Email: booking@motionpicbooth.com
Website: www.motionpicbooth.com

This pricing structure naturally creates a good, better, best progression:

  • Good: Drop-Off Booth ($250)

  • Better: Take One ($500)

  • Best Value: Director's Cut ($1,000)

  • Premium: Hollywood Deluxe ($1,500)
